newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: SOCCER-COSTA RICA TO SPY ON THEIR OWN COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COSTA RICA TO SPY ON THEIR OWN COACH.

text.p: Costa Rican soccer directors are to send an observer to this month's Copa America to spy on their own national team coach.
The spy's mission will be to observe the working methods of coach Horacio Cordero, fiercely criticised for his team's 1-0 defeat away to Canada in a World Cup qualifier last Sunday.

"Our man will travel incognito so that nobody gets in the way of his work," said an official of the Costa Rican federation, who asked not to be named. The official said the move was made by a federation committee.
Costa Rican fans were worried about the team's lethargic performance on Sunday when players appeared to lack motivation.

Costa Rica are regarded as one of the favourites to qualify from the CONCACAF region but their chances of taking one of the region's three places have been hampered by the defeat, which followed a previous defeat away to El Salvador.
The team, along with Mexico, have been invited to join the 10 South American nations for the three-week long tournament in Bolivia.
